lines.zh: 我弯着腰走，鼻子快贴地。
lines.en: I walk hunched, nose almost to the ground.

lines.zh: 脚趾抓着泥，一步一步挪。
lines.en: Toes grip the mud with each step.
The fin on my back spreads in the wind.
I walk along the treeline.
Water drips from my ears.
I am looking for shiny stones.
The thing in my hand swings.
Salt marks stay where I pass.
Nose to earth, I move slowly.

lines.zh: 一听到响，就抬头看一眼。
lines.en: Any noise and my head comes up.
The shells on my shoulders knock.
I took a long way around.
Short legs. Not fast.
My shadow is scaled.
I drag something bright.
I chew while I walk.
Standing, holding a gold nugget to my eye.

lines.zh: 舌尖绕着牙根转了一圈。
lines.en: My tongue rolls once around the roots of my teeth.
This pile is mine.
I crouch and study a stone.
My ears flick in the water.
I am not good at standing still.
Air bubbles out at my cheeks.
I count the pouches at my waist.
Head tilted, thinking.
I itch, and scratch my gills.
I tighten my grip on the gold.

lines.zh: 我在等一个掉东西的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone to drop something.
This ground is a bit dry.
My lips are dry, so I wet them once.
Do you have gold on you?
Hide what? I see all.
You are crowding me.
My nose is very keen.
Do you want a bite too?
I bite. Truly.
Your hands are trembling.
Your hand is moving behind you.
This patch of ground is mine.
Set it down and go.
Ow. My nose.
The pain makes me flinch.

lines.zh: 血顺着鳃边往下淌，滴进泥里。
lines.en: Blood runs down past my gills and drips into the mud.
I stumbled back two steps.
A crack in my shell.
You knocked my pouch loose.
I let out a thin shriek.

lines.zh: 这笔账，我咬着牙记下了。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and remember this one.
I still guard the gold.
Don't stop swinging — give me another one.
Gold. I smell gold.
That nugget. Give it here.
I smell gold.
That pouch at your waist.
One dropped nugget would do.
I am not greedy. I just want it.
Fish is fine. Gold is better.
Do not go yet. Let me look.
The bright thing in your palm.
Trade. I will trade you this.

lines.zh: 你碰了我肩上的壳，响了一声。
lines.en: You knock the shell on my shoulder and it rings.
Hey, watch where you walk.

lines.zh: 我往后缩了半步，壳又蹭到你。
lines.en: I shrink back half a step and my shell grazes you again.
Short legs. Poor balance.

lines.zh: 脚趾被踩了，你也不看路。
lines.en: You stepped on my toes without even looking where you walk.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的鼻子。
lines.en: Your knee met my nose.
That bump cost me nothing.
Move aside; don't block the way I'm going.
My fin scraped you.
Steady. Do not push me.
I must finish counting this gold.
You do not look like kin.
No one in the sea asked me.
My shell is too hard for that.
Wait. Let me tie my pouches.
Would that drop any gold?
My head cannot hold that much.
Do not lean up against me.
I have to guard this pile.
I have no interest in it.
It shines. That is gold.
I snatch it up at once.
Short fingers make picking slow.
This nugget is mine.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进最里面的口袋。
lines.en: I tuck it into my deepest pouch.
I bite it to check.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我先到先得。
lines.en: On the ground, first come first kept.
This does not taste good.

lines.zh: 拖起来，一路刮出长长的印。
lines.en: I drag it and scrape a long mark behind me.
Do not pick that up. I dropped it.
You have gold on you.
Your pocket rattles of gold.
Do not run. Leave the goods.

lines.zh: 腰上那袋鼓得像是装满了金。
lines.en: That pouch at your hip bulges as if it were full of gold.
I will take a bite first.
Target confirmed.
I steady the pouch at my waist.
Something alive is here.
I have blocked the way.
You will not get far.
I edge forward slowly.

lines.zh: 你手指头抖，我全看在眼里。
lines.en: Your fingers shake and I catch every twitch.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和血混着的味。
lines.en: You smell of iron mixed with blood.
Waiting for a chance to get close.
Footprints here. Yours.
I fold the fin on my back.
He is backing away.
Two more steps forward.

lines.zh: 牙关一松，尖的就全露在外。
lines.en: My jaw slackens and every point shows.
This spot will do.
A bite into his arm.
I ram with my shoulder.
Claws rake his leg.
That bite did not go deep.
I pounce and pin him.
He hit back. That hurt.
I shake my head and throw him off.
I bite and do not let go.
My teeth bite one layer deeper.
I pull back and guard my pouch.
I climb out of the shallows.

lines.zh: 身上的水甩得到处都是。
lines.en: Water flies off me everywhere.

lines.zh: 先看看附近有没有金子。
lines.en: First, let me see if there is gold nearby.
My gills are not dry yet.
This ground is too dry.
I tug at the pouch on my waist.
Who dropped something by the water?

lines.zh: 水草一拨开，我就站到岸上。
lines.en: I part the weeds and stand up on the bank.
My nose twitched first.
I am here. The goods are mine.
Fire dries my gills.
I land in the mud, soaked.
In water I am comfortable.
The blast throws me into the bushes.
An arrow pierces my back fin.

lines.zh: 那道光钻进牙缝，整排都麻。
lines.en: That light seeps between my teeth and numbs the whole row.
Hunger makes me bite more.
Current runs through the gold I hold.

lines.zh: 我抓不住，脚下的地没了。
lines.en: I cannot grip. The ground is gone.
